name: Naive Bayes
learningObjectives: Understand Bayes' theorem and its application to classification
Learn the 'naive' assumption of conditional independence between features
Explore how Gaussian distributions model feature likelihood
Interpret prior probabilities and their impact on predictions
Recognize when Naive Bayes performs well despite its simplifying assumptions
